release_contacts.description: Unified contacts list, segments and profile drawer (Contacts CRM v1).

release_data_store.description: Datasets, models and dynamic data bindings.

release_marketplace.description: Marketplace browsing, publishing and plugin installs.

release_commerce_v2.description: Commerce v2 wave: catalog, cart/checkout, digital goods, reservations, POS, repriced tiers (AGL-276..331).

release_marketing.description: Overlays, campaigns at-a-glance, and A/B experiments.

release_email.description: Designed emails, campaigns, and audience sending.

release_inbox.description: Form submissions, site members, and the lead inbox.

release_logic.description: Variables, no-code functions, and reference health.

release_addon_store.description: Self-serve add-on purchases on the Billing page: seats, datasets, extra sites, POS registers, Event Calendar.

release_native_checkout.description: Pay for a plan without leaving the console - Stripe embedded Checkout instead of a redirect. OFF by default until a real card has been through it.

release_edit_bar.description: Edit-access admin bar on published sites (admin edit bar, AGL-1302 follow-on). OFF until the cross-origin connect flow is verified on a live tenant domain; flipping off also invalidates outstanding edit tokens.

version.description: Release flags seed (AGL-231): one JSON parameter per release-gated console feature; managed in the staff admin Feature Flags page thereafter. AGL-1635: a value here is the PLATFORM default and is not the last word — an org doc may carry a per-org override at orgs/{orgId}.releaseFlags, set from the staff Override dialog, which wins over both the value below and its rollout percentage. If one organization sees a feature this file says is off, look there before editing anything here.
